text:
Anna M: FYI incoming security questionnaire from Acme. they flagged supply-chain proofing, KMS key custody, RBAC changes, and incident playbook questions.
Matt B: copy. can you drop the PDF here? I'll skim for anything blocking.
Anna M: attached (link) https://acme.example/sq/2026-03-redwood.pdf :eyes:
Jess R: quick note — Acme is enterprise, needs evidence for build pipeline provenance and 3rd-party dependency checks (SBOM / SLSA level). They also asked for KMS-backed key custody for customer data.
Omar K: on KMS: we currently envelope-encrypt customer data at rest using AWS KMS CMKs in the Redwoods-owned account for hosted, and we support customer-managed keys (CMKs) for Dedicated/Private via a customer KMS ARN. we need to state rotation cadence and envelope key flow.
Acme Sec - Raj: @Anna M thanks. can you confirm whether logs that show key usage are available for 12 months? we need cryptographic key access logs for audit.
Anna M: @Raj we keep CloudTrail for key usage in hosted for 13 months by default, can export to S3. For Private we recommend customers ship KMS logs to their SIEM. I'll call that out.
Matt B: re: RBAC changes — they want role separation between "platform ops" and "customer admin" and audit trail for role grants. we have RBAC events in our auth DB but need to show retention/immutable audit.
Jess R: action item: produce a short diagram + text describing RBAC model, grant flows, and audit retention. include sample query to fetch grants for a tenant.
Omar K: sample SQL snippet we can include:
```
SELECT grant_id, principal, role, object_id, created_at, granted_by
FROM rbac_grants
WHERE tenant_id = 'tenant-1234'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
Anna M: good. also they asked about incident response: timeline (detection -> containment -> notification), SLA for customer notification (72h for PII exposures), and whether we provide forensic artifacts (logs, root cause analysis).
Acme Sec - Raj: yes, include examples of delivered materials. also describe coordination with customer incident teams and cross-tenant isolation proof.
Matt B: vuln triage: they want our patching cadence and CVE handling workflow. we have weekly security triage + emergency patching. include our SLO for critical CVEs (48 hours to mitigation plan) and examples from past incidents.
Jess R: let's not paste past incident PII in doc, keep anonymized references.
Omar K: KMS integration Qs from PDF:
- do we support HSM-backed keys for Private? (yes)
- can customer provide keys via external KMS (Azure/AWS/GCP)? (yes, via ARN/Key resource)
- do we perform key escrow? (no)
I'll write concise answers.
Anna M: acme also asked about signed SBOM and reproducible builds proof. we can point to our CI pipeline using Cosign signatures and attestations in OCI registry. include example cosign commands.
Matt B: add a note on supply-chain security controls: locked deps, Dependabot automation, SBOM generation on every release, SLSA attestation level (we're working towards L2, currently L1 with plans).
Acme Sec - Raj: ok. last thing: audit log integrity. will you describe write-once storage or append-only logs and whether we provide signed log hashes? we need to show tamper evidence.
Jess R: current approach: CloudTrail + centralized log-shipper to an append-only S3 bucket with object lock enabled for accounts that request it. for hosted customers we can export signed daily log manifests. sample manifest format included.
Omar K: sample manifest (do not actual sign here):
```
{
  "date": "2026-03-05",
  "bucket": "redwood-hosted-audit-exports",
  "files": ["cloudtrail/2026-03-05-01.json.gz"],
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "signed_by": "key-id-abc123"
}
```
Anna M: timeline to produce SQ response draft: EOD Friday for tech appendices; legal will add attestation language next week. can everyone add short snippets by Thursday noon?
Matt B: I can handle RBAC + audit queries.
Jess R: I'll draft incident response and vuln triage workflows.
Omar K: I'll do KMS and key custody text + sample configs (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault examples).
Acme Sec - Raj: thanks team. if you can include a short runbook snippet for ransomware detection -> isolation, that would be helpful.
Anna M: added to tasks. also flagging potential ask: they may request a live security review call next week. anyone available Tue/Wed mornings?
Matt B: Tue morning works for me.
Jess R: Wed ok for me.
Omar K: Tue preferred.
Anna M: i'll propose Tue 10am PT and include an agenda: 1) SBOM/provenance, 2) KMS & key custody, 3) RBAC/audit, 4) incident coordination.
SE Bot: reminder: create tickets in #help for deliverables -> `#help create SQ: Acme - tech appendix` :white_check_mark:
Matt B: created ticket #4521
Anna M: thanks. I'll ping legal for attestation phrasing.
Acme Sec - Raj: great, looking forward to the call. one small clarifying Q: can you confirm whether export keys are ever stored in cleartext on the host? just need a short yes/no and one-line explanation.
Omar K: No. export keys are never persisted in plaintext on hosts. Envelope DEKs generated in memory for encryption operations; only wrapped keys stored with metadata. we will include a brief diagram.
Anna M: perfect. I'll assemble the draft and drop here for review before sending.
Matt B: ack.
Jess R: ack.
Omar K: ack.
Acme Sec - Raj: thanks all :thumbsup:
